items.title: Excitability
items.text: Responds to a nerve impulse or other stimulus

items.title: Extensibility
items.text: Can be stretched beyond its resting length

items.title: Elasticity
items.text: Returns to its original shape after stretching

items.title: Conductivity
items.text: Carries the impulse along the whole fibre

items.title: Fatigue
items.text: Repeated activity builds up lactic acid
